name: NEXT F Runtime Declaration
description: Declares the mandatory baseline runtime capabilities embedded in every NEXT F-integrated customer website.
purpose: Ensures future Sites have the common content, event, consent, integration and identity hooks needed after launch.

fields.description: Canonical Site identity runtime is present and enabled.
NEXT F structured-content connector is present and enabled.
NEXT F event/tracking abstraction is present and enabled.
NEXT F consent state layer is present and enabled.
NEXT F approved-integration loader is present and enabled.

validationRules.description: All five baseline runtime capabilities must be true for a Site claiming full NEXT F Website Platform integration.
The declaration asserts implementation support; it does not contain credentials, customer content or provider-specific configuration.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
